reason: Buku Besar dengan No Faktur Pajak & No Invoice (optimasi performa)
name: buku_besar_faktur_invoice
query:
WITH f AS (
  -- Baris jurnal yang lolos filter ({andWhere} diisi Zahir Online)
  SELECT G1.D, G1.ACCOUNT_ID, G1.ACCOUNT_CODE, G1.DEPARTMENT_ID, G1.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         G1.PROJECT_ID, G1.COST_CODE_ID, G1.CURRENCY_ID, G1.CONTACT_ID,
         G1.TRANSACTION_ID, G1.JURNAL_ID, G1.TYPE, G1.NOJURNAL, G1.KETERANGAN,
         G1.DEBIT, G1.KREDIT
  FROM (
    SELECT
      g.tanggal::date AS d,
      jv.account_id,
      k.code  AS account_code,
      jv.department_id,
      dp.code AS department_code,
      jv.project_id,
      jv.cost_code_id,
      g.contact_id,
      g.currency_id,
      g.id    AS transaction_id,
      jv.id   AS jurnal_id,
      g.type,
      g.nojurnal,
      g.keterangan,
      COALESCE(jv.debit, 0)::numeric  AS debit,
      COALESCE(jv.kredit, 0)::numeric AS kredit
    FROM g_jurnal g
    JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    JOIN kiraan k    ON k.id = jv.account_id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT d.id, NULLIF(COALESCE(to_jsonb(d) ->> 'code', to_jsonb(d) ->> 'kode'), '') AS code
      FROM dept d
    ) dp ON dp.id = jv.department_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
),
batas AS (
  SELECT MIN(d) AS tgl_awal FROM f
),
akun_list AS (
  SELECT
    k.id   AS account_id,
    k.code AS kode_akun,
    k.nama AS nama_akun,
    k2.noklasifikasi
  FROM kiraan k
  JOIN subklas s ON s.id = k.subclassification_id
  JOIN klas k2   ON k2.id = s.classification_id
  WHERE k.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM f)
),
saldo_awal AS (
  -- Neraca: akumulasi sejak awal; Laba rugi: sejak awal tahun periode
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    COALESCE(
      CASE
        WHEN a.noklasifikasi IN ('2','3','4','8')
          THEN SUM(COALESCE(j.kredit,0) - COALESCE(j.debit,0))
        ELSE SUM(COALESCE(j.debit,0) - COALESCE(j.kredit,0))
      END, 0)::numeric(18,2) AS saldo_awal
  FROM akun_list a
  CROSS JOIN batas b
  JOIN jurnalvc j ON j.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN g_jurnal g ON g.id = j.transaction_id
                 AND g.status = 'approved'
                 AND g.tanggal < b.tgl_awal
                 AND (a.noklasifikasi::integer < 4
                      OR g.tanggal >= date_trunc('year', b.tgl_awal::timestamp))
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.noklasifikasi
),
faktur_pajak AS (
  SELECT o.data_id, string_agg(o.value, ', ') AS value
  FROM other_fields o
  WHERE o."key" = '9'
    AND o.data_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT transaction_id FROM f)
  GROUP BY o.data_id
),
invoice_ref AS (
  -- child_id <> parent_id = transaksi pelunasan (pembayaran/retur)
  SELECT
    sb.child_id AS data_id,
    string_agg(gi.nojurnal, ', ' ORDER BY gi.tanggal, gi.nojurnal) AS no_invoice
  FROM subsider sb
  JOIN g_jurnal gi ON gi.id = sb.parent_id
  WHERE sb.child_id <> sb.parent_id
    AND sb.child_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT transaction_id FROM f)
  GROUP BY sb.child_id
),
trans_running AS (
  SELECT
    f.account_id,
    f.d AS tanggal,
    f.type,
    f.nojurnal,
    f.jurnal_id,
    COALESCE(c.perusahaan, '')   AS kontak,
    COALESCE(f.keterangan, '')   AS deskripsi,
    COALESCE(d.nama, '')         AS dept,
    COALESCE(p.namapekerjaan, '') AS proyek,
    COALESCE(fp.value, '')       AS faktur_pajak,
    COALESCE(ir.no_invoice, '')  AS no_invoice,
    f.debit,
    f.kredit,
    CASE
      WHEN a.noklasifikasi IN ('2','3','4','8')
        THEN SUM(f.kredit - f.debit) OVER w
      ELSE SUM(f.debit - f.kredit) OVER w
    END AS running_mutasi
  FROM f
  JOIN akun_list a          ON a.account_id = f.account_id
  LEFT JOIN cardfile c      ON c.contact_id = f.contact_id
  LEFT JOIN dept d          ON d.id = f.department_id
  LEFT JOIN job p           ON p.project_id = f.project_id
  LEFT JOIN faktur_pajak fp ON fp.data_id = f.transaction_id
  LEFT JOIN invoice_ref ir  ON ir.data_id = f.transaction_id
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY f.account_id
               ORDER BY f.d, f.nojurnal, f.jurnal_id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
mutasi AS (
  SELECT
    f.account_id,
    SUM(f.debit)::numeric(18,2)  AS total_debit,
    SUM(f.kredit)::numeric(18,2) AS total_kredit,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(a.noklasifikasi) IN ('2','3','4','8') THEN SUM(f.kredit - f.debit)
      ELSE SUM(f.debit - f.kredit)
    END::numeric(18,2) AS total_mutasi
  FROM f
  JOIN akun_list a ON a.account_id = f.account_id
  GROUP BY f.account_id
),
akun AS (
  -- satu baris per akun, lengkap dengan saldo awal & mutasi (dipakai 6 cabang di bawah)
  SELECT a.account_id, a.kode_akun, a.nama_akun,
         COALESCE(s.saldo_awal,0)   AS saldo_awal,
         COALESCE(m.total_debit,0)  AS total_debit,
         COALESCE(m.total_kredit,0) AS total_kredit,
         COALESCE(m.total_mutasi,0) AS total_mutasi,
         b.tgl_awal
  FROM akun_list a
  CROSS JOIN batas b
  LEFT JOIN saldo_awal s ON s.account_id = a.account_id
  LEFT JOIN mutasi m     ON m.account_id = a.account_id
),
gabungan AS (
  -- 0: judul akun
  SELECT kode_akun, nama_akun, 0::numeric AS urutan_sort,
         NULL::text AS tanggal, kode_akun AS tipe, nama_akun AS referensi,
         NULL::text AS kontak, NULL::text AS deskripsi, NULL::text AS dept, NULL::text AS proyek,
         NULL::text AS faktur_pajak, NULL::text AS no_invoice,
         NULL::text AS debit, NULL::text AS kredit, NULL::text AS saldo
  FROM akun
  UNION ALL
  -- 0.5: header kolom
  SELECT kode_akun, nama_akun, 0.5,
         'TANGGAL', 'TIPE', 'REFERENSI', 'KONTAK', 'DESKRIPSI', 'DEPT', 'PROYEK',
         'NO FAKTUR PAJAK', 'NO INVOICE', 'DEBIT', 'KREDIT', 'SALDO'
  FROM akun
  UNION ALL
  -- 1: saldo awal
  SELECT kode_akun, nama_akun, 1,
         (tgl_awal - 1)::text, 'Saldo Awal', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
         '0', '0',
         CASE WHEN saldo_awal = 0 THEN '0' ELSE to_char(saldo_awal, 'FM999,999,999,999,999.00') END
  FROM akun
  UNION ALL
  -- 2: transaksi
  SELECT a.kode_akun, a.nama_akun, 2,
         t.tanggal::text, t.type, t.nojurnal, t.kontak, t.deskripsi, t.dept, t.proyek,
         t.faktur_pajak, t.no_invoice,
         CASE WHEN t.debit  = 0 THEN '0' ELSE to_char(t.debit,  'FM999,999,999,999,999.00') END,
         CASE WHEN t.kredit = 0 THEN '0' ELSE to_char(t.kredit, 'FM999,999,999,999,999.00') END,
         CASE WHEN a.saldo_awal + t.running_mutasi = 0 THEN '0'
              ELSE to_char((a.saldo_awal + t.running_mutasi)::numeric(18,2), 'FM999,999,999,999,999.00') END
  FROM trans_running t
  JOIN akun a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  UNION ALL
  -- 3: total debit/kredit
  SELECT kode_akun, nama_akun, 3,
         NULL, 'Saldo Awal', NULL, NULL,
         CASE WHEN saldo_awal = 0 THEN '0' ELSE to_char(saldo_awal, 'FM999,999,999,999,999.00') END,
         NULL, 'Total :', NULL, NULL,
         CASE WHEN total_debit  = 0 THEN '0' ELSE to_char(total_debit,  'FM999,999,999,999,999.00') END,
         CASE WHEN total_kredit = 0 THEN '0' ELSE to_char(total_kredit, 'FM999,999,999,999,999.00') END,
         NULL
  FROM akun
  UNION ALL
  -- 4: saldo akhir / mutasi
  SELECT kode_akun, nama_akun, 4,
         NULL, 'Saldo Akhir', NULL, NULL,
         CASE WHEN saldo_awal + total_mutasi = 0 THEN '0'
              ELSE to_char((saldo_awal + total_mutasi)::numeric(18,2), 'FM999,999,999,999,999.00') END,
         NULL, 'Mutasi :', NULL, NULL,
         CASE WHEN total_mutasi = 0 THEN '0' ELSE to_char(total_mutasi, 'FM999,999,999,999,999.00') END,
         NULL, NULL
  FROM akun
  UNION ALL
  -- 5: baris kosong pemisah
  SELECT kode_akun, nama_akun, 5,
         NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
  FROM akun
),
hasil AS (
  SELECT kode_akun, nama_akun, urutan_sort, tanggal, tipe, referensi, kontak, deskripsi,
         dept, proyek, faktur_pajak, no_invoice, debit, kredit, saldo
  FROM gabungan
)
SELECT kode_akun, nama_akun, urutan_sort AS urutan, tanggal, tipe, referensi, kontak, deskripsi, dept, proyek,
       faktur_pajak, no_invoice, debit, kredit, saldo
FROM hasil
ORDER BY kode_akun, urutan_sort, tanggal NULLS LAST, referensi {andOrder} {limit}

WITH f AS (
  SELECT G1.D, G1.ACCOUNT_ID, G1.ACCOUNT_CODE, G1.DEPARTMENT_ID, G1.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         G1.PROJECT_ID, G1.COST_CODE_ID, G1.CURRENCY_ID, G1.CONTACT_ID,
         G1.TRANSACTION_ID, G1.NOJURNAL, G1.KETERANGAN
  FROM (
    SELECT
      g.tanggal::date AS d,
      jv.account_id,
      k.code  AS account_code,
      jv.department_id,
      dp.code AS department_code,
      jv.project_id,
      jv.cost_code_id,
      g.contact_id,
      g.currency_id,
      g.id    AS transaction_id,
      g.nojurnal,
      g.keterangan
    FROM g_jurnal g
    JOIN jurnalvc jv ON jv.transaction_id = g.id
    JOIN kiraan k    ON k.id = jv.account_id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT d.id, NULLIF(COALESCE(to_jsonb(d) ->> 'code', to_jsonb(d) ->> 'kode'), '') AS code
      FROM dept d
    ) dp ON dp.id = jv.department_id
    WHERE g.status = 'approved'
  ) G1
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
)
SELECT COUNT(*) + 6 * COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM f
